children: rose 3.06% premarket after Reuters reported that SK Hynix

is in talks with Intel to manufacture memory chips on US soil for the first time, citing three people familiar with the discussions. One scenario has SK Hynix leasing part of Intel's Ohio facility. Another has it forming a venture with Intel and cloud companies looking to lock in memory supply. SK Hynix shares closed 4.1% higher in Seoul.

In 2022, Intel announced that it would invest up to $100 billion in the Ohio site, with production scheduled for 2025. Completion of the two plants has since slipped to 2030 and 2031. Intel declined to comment on what it called speculation, while saying it continues investing to ready the site.

Any agreement covering advanced memory such as HBM or DRAM could face opposition, with South Korea's trade ministry noting that a "national core technology" would trigger review under the Industrial Technology Protection Act. SK Hynix said it is reviewing various measures including additional production bases, but that nothing has been determined. US manufacturing costs considerably more than Korean, with higher labor and construction costs and a supply chain concentrated in Asia.

title: Intel Rises 3% on SK Hynix Talks Over Ohio Capacity
